# MedAtlas Knowledge Base (Complete Directory)
> Comprehensive plain-language medical device reference across 15 health areas and 100 device guides.

Founder: Ankush Kumar (MBA Pharmaceutical Management, B.Pharm; 4+ years pharmaceutical and medical-device industry experience).
Website: https://medatlas.health
Standards Referenced: WHO Medical Devices, FDA Product Classification Database, European Commission EMDN.
